Permitted Predictive Claim: Higher scores indicate higher relative model priority within the evaluated data.
Prohibited Causal Claim: A higher score causes a donor to donate or represents a literal donation probability.
Reason: The output is uncalibrated and was developed for ranking.

Permitted Predictive Claim: A feature contributed to how the fitted model generated predictions.
Prohibited Causal Claim: Changing the feature will cause a change in donation behavior.
Reason: Feature importance measures predictive use within a fitted model rather than an intervention effect.

Permitted Predictive Claim: A feature value was associated with an increase or decrease in the model output for the evaluated record.
Prohibited Causal Claim: The feature value caused the donor's outcome or would change the outcome if altered.
Reason: SHAP explains model output and does not identify causal relationships.

Permitted Predictive Claim: The fitted model showed a response pattern across observed feature values.
Prohibited Causal Claim: Moving a donor to another feature value will produce the plotted change in real donation behavior.
Reason: The plots summarize fitted model behavior under the observed data distribution.

Permitted Predictive Claim: The model contained a candidate joint pattern between the evaluated features.
Prohibited Causal Claim: One feature causally changes the effect of the other feature on donation.
Reason: The interaction analysis is exploratory and model specific.

Permitted Predictive Claim: Observed model or outcome rates differed across sufficiently supported groups in the held out sample.
Prohibited Causal Claim: Group membership caused the disparity or reflects an inherent difference in donor behavior.
Reason: The comparisons are observational and may reflect sample composition, proxy variables, or unmeasured factors.

Permitted Predictive Claim: Historical donation measures collectively provided predictive information to the model.
Prohibited Causal Claim: A specific historical donation measure independently caused current year donor status.
Reason: The measures are strongly correlated and their importance may be redistributed.
